descriptionPlain:
Siteimprove makes software that helps organisations keep their websites accessible, well written and easy to find. Our platform brings content quality and content performance together, for human readers and AI systems alike.
We are hiring an Account Executive to win new customers in the UK. You will own new business from first contact to signature, build relationships with senior buyers, and help them solve real problems with their digital content.
You will work with marketing, digital, accessibility, communications and IT teams to understand their needs and show how our platform helps. We welcome applicants from every background, even if you do not match every point below.

lists.content:
• Run the whole sales cycle for a set of enterprise accounts, both new logos and expansion
  • Build trust with senior buyers in Marketing, Digital, IT, Accessibility and Procurement
  • Keep forecasts and pipeline up to date in Salesforce
  • Represent Siteimprove at events and customer forums across EMEA

lists.text: What we will require of you
lists.content:
• 5+ years of SaaS sales with a record of winning new business
  • Experience selling martech or digital experience software
  • Comfort with long, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

lists.text: In addition, we hope you will appreciate:
lists.content:
Rest and relaxation: 25 days of annual holiday.

Comprehensive benefits: Private medical cover and a weekly lunch allowance.

Prepare for the future: A company pension.

additionalPlain:
Siteimprove is an equal opportunity employer
 
Every qualified applicant is considered regardless of race, colour, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information or any other protected status.
 
Personal data from your application may be processed and stored in several countries as described in our Privacy Policy at https://siteimprove.com/en/privacy/.
